treatment_summary: The patient is already on lisinopril 10 mg, a NICE‑recommended first‑line ACE‑inhibitor. Because clinic BP remains stage 2 (151/105 mmHg), add amlodipine 5 mg once daily as the NICE‑recommended second‑line partner. Monitor BP after 2 weeks and titrate to 10 mg if needed. Obtain baseline renal function, electrolytes, eGFR, and confirm pregnancy status before any dose change. Arrange QRISK assessment, lifestyle counseling (salt <6 g/day, DASH diet, 150 min/week exercise, weight control, limit alcohol, smoking cessation) and schedule a medication review in 4 weeks.
